films.title: Arbitrary Function
films.description: Antihero Skateboards' 2019 Implosionistic Tendencies installment is a compact team film credited to the Grimple Brothers. Arbitrary Function features Frank Gerwer, Tony Trujillo, Grant Taylor, Chris Pfanner, Austin Kanfoush, Ishod Wair, Raney Beres, Daan Van Der Linden and seven more skaters.

films.title: Through and Through
films.description: REAL Skateboards' 2015 full-length grew out of everyday sessions with the team rather than a planned production. Filmed by Jeremy McNamara and Tim Fulton, the 17-minute film features Dennis Busenitz, Ishod Wair, Peter Ramondetta, Kyle Walker, Chima Ferguson and twelve more REAL riders.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable full video on REAL Skateboards' official channel; exact runtime 17:32 and upload date October 12, 2015. The description identifies it as the complete film and explains its informal team-session origin.

films.title: Doll
films.description: Girl Skateboards' 2018 full-length introduces Niels Bennett and Griffin Gass alongside a wide Girl and Chocolate cast. Directed by John Marello, Rye Beres and Cory Weincheque, Doll combines team parts and satirical office skits in a 30-minute production.
